erebos.description: Erebos pentest orchestrator (remote, erebos-server) — fleet scanning, vulnerability discovery, exploitation, and reporting

tools.name: fleet-scan
tools.description: Launch a full fleet scan with parallel agents (recon, vuln-scan, exploit, code-audit, reporter)

target.description: Target hostname or IP (must be in allowlist)

repos.description: Optional repo paths for code-aware scanning

auth_header.description: Auth header for authenticated scanning (e.g. 'Authorization: Bearer ey...')

auth_cookie.description: Cookie string for authenticated scanning (e.g. 'PHPSESSID=abc; security=low')

tools.name: scan
tools.description: Run a single-phase scan (recon, vuln-scan, or exploit)

tools.name: status
tools.description: Get status of a running or completed scan

scan_id.description: Scan ID returned by scan tool

tools.name: findings
tools.description: List findings from a scan, filtered by severity

scan_id.description: Scan ID to get findings for
